solutions.latex:
Read each activity from the network. The immediate predecessors are the activities that must finish before it can start, and the dashed arrow is a dummy activity showing that $F$ also needs $B$ finished.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Activity} & \text{Duration} & \text{Immediate predecessor} \\ \hline A & 4 & - \\ B & 4 & A \\ C & 5 & A \\ D & 8 & A \\ E & 9 & D \\ F & 7 & B,\ C \\ G & 3 & B \\ H & 2 & E,\ F,\ G \\ \hline \end{array}$$
$B$, $C$ and $D$ all start after $A$. $E$ starts at the end of $D$. $F$ starts after $C$ and, through the dummy, after $B$. $G$ starts after $B$. $H$ starts after $E$, $F$ and $G$ are all complete.

7549.stem:
Augustin is following a recipe for a cake. A summary of the steps in the recipe is as follows:

\begin{itemize}
\item A: Preheat oven (10 minutes)
\item B: Mix dry ingredients (5 minutes)
\item C: Mix wet ingredients (5 minutes)
\item D: When B and C are done, mix dry and wet ingredients (10 minutes)
\item E: When D is done, pour batter into pan (2 minutes)
\item F: When A and E are done, put pan into oven and bake (50 minutes)
\item G: When F is done, prepare frosting (10 minutes)
\item H: When F is done, place cake in fridge to cool (30 minutes)
\item I: When G is done, prepare decorations (5 minutes)
\item J: When H and I are done, frost cake and serve (10 minutes)
\end{itemize}

figures.cap: partial activity network with A, B, C, D, F
solution sketch: completed activity network with earliest and latest times

parts.latex: What is the latest time after starting the recipe that the oven needs to begin preheating?

Augustin realises as he is about to make the frosting that he forgot to buy an ingredient for the frosting. He takes some time to run to the store and back for the ingredient and starts preparing the frosting 20 minutes late.

How will this delay affect the minimum completion time of the recipe?

solutions.latex:
Activity G has a float of 15 mins; the delay of 20 mins exceeds it by 5 mins.

This will delay him by 5 mins. His new minimum completion time will be $112$ mins.

solutions.latex:
An activity's immediate predecessors are the activities that finish at the node where it starts. List them for each activity:

$$\begin{aligned} &A,\ B,\ C: \text{ none (start at Start)} \\ &D: A \qquad E: B \qquad F: B \qquad G: C \\ &H: D \text{ and } E \\ &I: F \text{ and } G \\ &J: H \text{ and } I \end{aligned}$$

The activities with exactly two immediate predecessors are $H$, $I$ and $J$.

So there are 3 of them, which is option C.
